title: Queue Reconstruction by Height
goal: Solve Queue Reconstruction by Height: Reconstruct queue from (height, k) pairs where k is the count of people taller or equal height before this person.
strategy: Reconstruct queue from (height, k) pairs where k is the count of people taller or equal height before this person.
edgeCases: Process taller people before shorter ones so insertion at index k counts only people at least as tall.
